rationale: The plan correctly refuses count models and voom, runs limma-trend (eBayes trend=TRUE) on the log2(TPM+1) values as delivered with an explicit value-range check, a log-scale filter tied to the smallest group size, and BH at 0.05 with control as reference and direction stated. Deductions: it leaves the design formula ambiguous ('~0 + condition or ~condition'), floats a downstream quantile-normalization sensitivity run that the reference explicitly excludes, and reports |logFC|>1 as a post-hoc count rather than testing against it. Enrichment was not requested; the plan adds preranked GSEA that is mostly well specified (signed t, tested-gene universe, 15-500 window) but omits collection versions. The report section names method, design, thresholds and caveats but does not commit to reporting software versions.
